name: Silt Strider fast travel policy
notes: Authored rules, versioned independently of any extraction snapshot.

The travel records carry no faction or rank requirement: profile_destinations is (profile, provider, entry, cell, status) and nothing more. Rank gating lives in dialogue conditions, so it is authored here rather than claimed as derived.
The builder verifies every edge named below exists in the extracted data and fails if one does not, so a renamed cell cannot silently empty a rule.
Site toggles: mageGuildMember (default on), conjurerRank (default off, Tamriel Rebuilt only).

guildGuide.note: A guild guide is a travel provider whose every destination is a Mages Guild cell. Identifying them by the NPC class 'Guild Guide' misses Thazlorakis, the bound Daedroth who serves as Firewatch's Conjurer-rank guide and is a CREA record with no class. The builder cross-checks the two rules and reports every disagreement.

conjurerRank.note: Tamriel Rebuilt gates the long-distance guild guide network between Vivec, Old Ebonheart, Firewatch and Narsis behind the Mages Guild rank of Conjurer. Each city keeps a short-range guide that is not gated: Soril in Firewatch still reaches Helnim and Nivalis with the toggle off.

modes.note: The travel mode is the provider's class. Anything unlisted publishes mode null rather than a guess; those are one-off transports, not a network.
